description: AstroOrbitX. is a health-monitoring platform designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It tracks vital signs, visualizes health trends, and identifies potentially concerning changes through data analysis and intelligent alerts. The platform provides clear health insights and actionable guidance, helping astronauts evaluate their health status and make informed decisions despite the challenges of space radiation, altered gravity, isolation, and limited medical support.
summary: AstroOrbitX is a space-health awareness platform designed to help astronauts organize, manage, and review their health measurements. It provides a centralized dashboard where users can securely access their accounts and maintain personal health records. The platform aims to make health information easier to organize and understand, supporting awareness of health measurements during space missions. By combining modern web technologies with a user-friendly interface, AstroOrbitX offers a foundation for future space-health data management solutions. It is an independent prototype, not a medical diagnostic system or a NASA-endorsed product.
details:
AstroOrbitX is a web-based platform developed to support astronaut health-data organization and awareness. Users can create accounts, access their profiles, and manage health measurement records through a centralized dashboard.

The frontend uses React, TypeScript, and Vite, while the backend is built with Python and FastAPI. PostgreSQL with Neon provides database storage, supported by SQLAlchemy and Alembic. The project uses GitHub for version control and Netlify and Render for deployment.

AstroOrbitX focuses on usability, secure access, reliable data storage, and clear presentation of health information. It aims to contribute to future digital solutions for human space exploration. The platform is an independent prototype and is not clinically validated or endorsed by NASA.
